canonical_candidate_yaml:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: checkout-egress
  namespace: payments
spec:
  egress:
    - ports:
        - port: 53
          protocol: UDP
        - port: 53
          protocol: TCP
      to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
          podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              k8s-app: kube-dns
    - ports:
        - port: 5432
          protocol: TCP
      to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: payments-data
          podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: postgres
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: checkout-api
  policyTypes:
    - Egress
